candidats.description: “ Red tape ” used to bind bundles of redeemed Civil War-era Confederacy bond coupons. Part of an extensive collection ( Smithsonian Institution ) of fiscal documents seized by the Union Army from the Confederacy immediately after the assassination of President Lincoln .
categories: Bonds of the Confederate States of America
